hints.title: Signed Cash Flow Mapping
hints.text: Buying a stock represents a cash outflow (negative price), while selling is a cash inflow (positive price).

hints.title: Conditional Summation
hints.text: Use sum(case when operation = "Buy" then -price else price end) to compute net gain or loss per stock.

hints.title: Stock Grouping
hints.text: group by stock_name to aggregate all buy and sell transactions across each asset.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT stock_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'Buy' THEN -price ELSE price END) AS capital_gain_loss
FROM Stocks
GROUP BY stock_name;
```

complexity.notes: Single group-by aggregation over stock_name hashes transactions in linear time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate queries or subqueries for buys and sells require extra table scans and complex joins.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: CASE expression inside SUM computes the net balance in a single table pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Conditional aggregation mapping operations to signed coefficients.

solutions.code:
SELECT stock_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'Buy' THEN -price ELSE price END) AS capital_gain_loss
FROM Stocks
GROUP BY stock_name;

SELECT stock_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN operation = 'Buy' THEN -price ELSE price END) AS capital_gain_loss
FROM Stocks
GROUP BY stock_name;

import pandas as pd

def capital_gainloss(stocks: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    stocks['signed_price'] = stocks.apply(lambda r: -r['price'] if r['operation'] == 'Buy' else r['price'], axis=1)
    res = stocks.groupby('stock_name')['signed_price'].sum().reset_index()
    res.rename(columns={'signed_price': 'capital_gain_loss'}, inplace=True)
    return res
